id./param/scenario/cs/a_110_cs_050.pack|cs_: "Oh dear, you caught me in an embarrassing moment.
"I was remembering Lady Eleanor. Yes, your mother.
"...Why don't we talk a little as we walk?
"My mother was sickly. She died soon after I was born...
"Lady Eleanor worried about me, read picture books to me and invited me to pick flowers. She was truly a kind person...
"So when I heard Lady Eleanor was expecting a child, I was truly happy. It felt like I was getting a sibling...
"Yes... The day sixteen years ago when I last saw Lady Eleanor was a rainy day like this too...
"It seems to be your pursuers. There are a lot of them... If anyone can send that many pursuers...
"{var:1}! Let's hurry back to the others!
